test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following commissions is mentioned in the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Union Public Service Commission.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Union Public Service Commission, commonly abbreviated as UPSC, is India's premier central recruitment agency for the recruitment of all the Group 'A' officers under the Government of India
 
• The UPSC is India's premier central recruiting agency, its under the Department of Personnel and Training, Government of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The National Commission for Women (NCW) is the statutory body of the Government of India, generally concerned with advising the government on all policy matters affecting women.
 
• The Competition Commission of India is the chief national competition regulator in India. It is a statutory body within the Ministry of Corporate Affairs and is responsible for enforcing the Competition 
 
• The National Human Rights Commission of India is a statutory public body constituted on 12 October 1993 under the Protection of Human Rights Ordinance of 28 September 1993. It was given a statutory basis by the Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993
